title: Your to-do list should only contain decisions.
hook: Imagine a to-do list where every item is a decision, never a task.
thesis: TenantOS uses an owner inbox pattern: the human sees only what genuinely needs a decision, and each item says what happened, why the owner is needed, and what happens if they do nothing. Nothing in the inbox is a task the machine could have handled. This post teaches the pattern as a design idea any builder can steal.

verified: The owner inbox pattern: show the human only what needs a decision, with what happens if they do nothing (TENANTOS-HARVEST-ORDER.md, via SYSTEMS.md section 3).
